\chapter{Project Mandate}
\label{\detokenize{mandate:project-mandate}}\label{\detokenize{mandate::doc}}

\section{Purpose}
\label{\detokenize{mandate:purpose}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The purpose of this project is to investigate, document, and rectify the historical dispossession of the Buckler family from Great House Farm, Llandough, and to resolve the fraudulent claims associated with the 1987 “BP vs Buckler” case.


\section{Background}
\label{\detokenize{mandate:background}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
In 1987, legal proceedings (BP vs Buckler) were initiated based on what is alleged to be identity fraud concerning Mary Williams. This resulted in the Buckler family losing their rightful occupancy and ownership of Great House Farm. Recent research into the National Archives and Land Registry records has revealed systemic failures and potential administrative mistakes in the register.


\section{Objectives}
\label{\detokenize{mandate:objectives}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Establish the legal “identity fraud” baseline for Mary Williams.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Secure a “Phase 2” resolution from HM Land Registry regarding Title WA231076.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Obtain a clear position from the Welsh Government and MoJ on the historical fraud.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Restore the rightful title and/or compensation for the heirs of Mary Williams.

\end{itemize}


\section{Scope}
\label{\detokenize{mandate:scope}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{In\sphinxhyphen{}Scope}: Investigation of Land Registry Title WA231076; Correspondence with Senedd, MoJ, MoD, and Vale Council; Historical records analysis.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Out\sphinxhyphen{}of\sphinxhyphen{}Scope}: Current unrelated land disputes in the Llandough area not involving the original Williams/Buckler family assets.

\end{itemize}


\section{Constraints}
\label{\detokenize{mandate:constraints}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Transition/Dissolution of the Senedd (May 2026).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Institutional inertia from CADW and the Vale of Glamorgan Council.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Procedural complexity of “Stage Two” complaints at HM Land Registry.

\end{itemize}


\section{Stakeholders}
\label{\detokenize{mandate:stakeholders}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Project Board}: Sion Buckler and heirs of Mary Williams.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Interested Parties}: HM Land Registry, Ministry of Defence, Welsh Government, Vale of Glamorgan Council.

\end{itemize}

\sphinxstepscope


\chapter{Project Brief}
\label{\detokenize{brief:project-brief}}\label{\detokenize{brief::doc}}

\section{Project Definition}
\label{\detokenize{brief:project-definition}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The project aims to challenge the 1987 dispossession via administrative and legal channels, specifically targeting the Land Registry’s “mistake in the register” provisions.


\section{Business Case}
\label{\detokenize{brief:business-case}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The restoration of Great House Farm is not merely a matter of family property but a test of the integrity of the Welsh Land Registry system and its ability to correct historical fraud. The “BP vs Buckler” case stands as a documented instance of contested legal identity that must be resolved to ensure public confidence in land titles.


\section{Project Quality Management}
\label{\detokenize{brief:project-quality-management}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Quality will be measured by the successful escalation of complaints to Stage Two/Three and the receipt of legible, substantive responses from government ministers that address the fraud allegations directly rather than pivoting to administrative excuses.


\section{Project Team Structure}
\label{\detokenize{brief:project-team-structure}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Project Manager}: Sion Buckler

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Senior User}: Heirs of Mary Williams

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Senior Supplier}: Legal and Historical Researchers

\end{itemize}


\section{Project Approach}
\label{\detokenize{brief:project-approach}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The approach follows an escalation ladder:
\begin{enumerate}
\sphinxsetlistlabels{\arabic}{enumi}{enumii}{}{.}%
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Administrative}: Exhausting internal complaint procedures (Land Registry, Ombudsman).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Political}: Leveraging Senedd and Parliamentary oversight (MS/MP engagement).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
\sphinxstylestrong{Legal}: Direct challenge to the 1987 proceedings if administrative remedies fail.

\end{enumerate}

\sphinxstepscope


\chapter{Project Plan}
\label{\detokenize{plan:project-plan}}\label{\detokenize{plan::doc}}

\section{Description}
\label{\detokenize{plan:description}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
The project is structured into three distinct stages of resolution.


\subsection{Stage 1: Documentation \& Initial Filing (Complete)}
\label{\detokenize{plan:stage-1-documentation-initial-filing-complete}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Retrieval of National Archives records.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Initial filing of “Mistake in the Register” with Land Registry.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Identification of key stakeholders (BP, MoD, CADW).

\end{itemize}


\subsection{Stage 2: Formal Escalation (Current)}
\label{\detokenize{plan:stage-2-formal-escalation-current}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Filing of Stage Two complaints with Land Registry.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Challenging the “Investigation” shield used by the MoD.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Overcoming the “Nothing to do with us” stance from CADW.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Forcing a Full Response from Joe Martin MS and others after the “setting up office” delay.

\end{itemize}


\subsection{Stage 3: Legal/Ombudsman Resolution (Scheduled for Q3 2026)}
\label{\detokenize{plan:stage-3-legal-ombudsman-resolution-scheduled-for-q3-2026}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Referral to the Public Services Ombudsman for Wales (if Stage 1/2 fail).

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
Application to the Land Registry Tribunal.

\end{itemize}


\section{Planning Assumptions}
\label{\detokenize{plan:planning-assumptions}}\begin{itemize}
\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
That the National Archives records provide sufficient evidence of the 1987 discrepancy.

\item {} 
\sphinxAtStartPar
That the MoD’s internal investigation will eventually be subject to Freedom of Information or Parliamentary oversight.

\end{itemize}


\section{Monitoring and Control}
\label{\detokenize{plan:monitoring-and-control}}
\sphinxAtStartPar
Progress is monitored via weekly email reviews and the maintenance of a Highlight Report documenting institutional positions.
